en.headline: A six-page laminated PMBOK Guide 7th Edition cheat sheet for last-minute PMP review
en.intro: This QuickStudy pamphlet by Aileen Ellis condenses the PMBOK Guide for the 7th Edition into six laminated pages, which suits a final check before the PMP exam. Our concierge checks the item details and price before listing, and we buy it from the overseas seller after you order, typically 7–14 business days to reach you.
highlights: The laminated six-page pamphlet format lets you skim the key points quickly.
It is written in English, so you learn the exam terms in their original wording.
The title names the PMBOK Guide 7th Edition, so it fits anyone studying to that edition.
At 2.4 ounces (about 68 g) and 8.5 x 11 inches, it is easy to carry in a bag.
It works as a final review before the exam without carrying a thick textbook.

sections.p: Use it as a last-pass review: skim the sheets to refresh the key ideas just before the exam. It is a 6-page pamphlet published by QuickStudy on May 1, 2023 (ISBN-13 978-1423231127).

sections.h: Size and who it is for
sections.p: The sheet measures 8.5 x 0.06 x 11 inches (about 21.6 x 0.15 x 27.9 cm) and weighs 2.4 ounces. It suits PMP candidates who read English comfortably and want a compact refresher.

cautions: English-language edition only, not a Korean translation.
Check that the PMBOK Guide edition named in the title matches the exam content you are studying.
